description: Test whether the sel0 N-terminal extension has the sequence features of a mitochondrial targeting presequence, benchmarked against S. pombe proteins with annotated transit peptides versus annotated cytosolic proteins without one
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb"
def stream_fasta(q):
    r=requests.get(f"{U}/stream",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta"},timeout=600); r.raise_for_status()
    seqs={}; acc=None; buf=[]
    for ln in r.text.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(">"):
            if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
            acc=ln.split("|")[1] if "|" in ln else ln[1:].split()[0]; buf=[]
        elif ln.strip(): buf.append(ln.strip())
    if acc: seqs[acc]="".join(buf)
    return seqs

pos = stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:284812 AND ft_transit:*")
neg = stream_fasta("reviewed:true AND organism_id:284812 AND cc_scl_term:SL-0091 NOT ft_transit:*")
print("S. pombe reviewed with annotated transit peptide (positives):", len(pos))
print("S. pombe reviewed cytosolic, no transit peptide (negatives):", len(neg))

# Eisenberg consensus hydrophobicity scale
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)

def feats(s, N=40, win=18):
    seg=s[:N]
    if len(seg)<win: return None
    pos_c=sum(seg.count(c) for c in "KR"); neg_c=sum(seg.count(c) for c in "DE")
    h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0.0) for c in seg])
    # max hydrophobic moment over sliding windows, 100 deg periodicity (alpha helix)
    ang=np.deg2rad(100.0)*np.arange(win)
    mu=[]
    for i in range(len(seg)-win+1):
        w=h[i:i+win]
        mu.append(np.sqrt((w*np.cos(ang)).sum()**2+(w*np.sin(ang)).sum()**2)/win)
    return dict(net_charge=pos_c-neg_c, n_Arg=seg.count("R"), n_acidic=neg_c,
                frac_ST=(seg.count("S")+seg.count("T"))/len(seg),
                max_hyd_moment=float(max(mu)), mean_hydrophobicity=float(h.mean()))

rows=[]
for lab,db in [("transit_peptide",pos),("cytosolic",neg)]:
    for a,s in db.items():
        f=feats(s)
        if f: rows.append(dict(acc=a,group=lab,**f))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
sel0=("".join(requests.get(f"{U}/O13890.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]))
sf=feats(sel0); sf_row=dict(acc="O13890",group="sel0",**sf)
print("\nsel0 N-terminal 40 aa:", sel0[:40])
print("sel0 features:", {k:(round(v,3) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in sf.items()})

y=(df.group=="transit_peptide").astype(int).values
res=[]
for feat in ["net_charge","n_Arg","n_acidic","frac_ST","max_hyd_moment","mean_hydrophobicity"]:
    x=df[feat].values
    auc=roc_auc_score(y,x)
    m_pos=df.loc[df.group=="transit_peptide",feat].mean(); m_neg=df.loc[df.group=="cytosolic",feat].mean()
    sd=np.sqrt((df.loc[df.group=="transit_peptide",feat].var()+df.loc[df.group=="cytosolic",feat].var())/2)
    d=(m_pos-m_neg)/sd if sd>0 else np.nan
    pct_pos=100*(df.loc[df.group=="transit_peptide",feat].values<sf[feat]).mean()
    pct_neg=100*(df.loc[df.group=="cytosolic",feat].values<sf[feat]).mean()
    res.append(dict(feature=feat, auc_transit_vs_cyto=round(auc,3), mean_transit=round(m_pos,3),
                    mean_cytosolic=round(m_neg,3), cohens_d=round(d,2), sel0_value=round(sf[feat],3),
                    sel0_pct_within_transit=round(pct_pos,1), sel0_pct_within_cytosolic=round(pct_neg,1)))
R=pd.DataFrame(res)
R.to_csv("table13_mts_features.csv",index=False)
print()
print(R.to_string(index=False))

# simple composite: the two best discriminators
best=R.sort_values("auc_transit_vs_cyto",ascending=False).feature.tolist()
print("\nbest discriminators:",best[:3])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
for ax,feat in zip(axes,best[:3]):
    bins=np.histogram_bin_edges(df[feat],bins=25)
    ax.hist(df.loc[df.group=="cytosolic",feat],bins=bins,alpha=0.55,label=f"cytosolic (n={(df.group=='cytosolic').sum()})",color="#7aa6c2",density=True)
    ax.hist(df.loc[df.group=="transit_peptide",feat],bins=bins,alpha=0.55,label=f"transit peptide (n={(df.group=='transit_peptide').sum()})",color="#c2724a",density=True)
    ax.axvline(sf[feat],color="k",lw=2.2,ls="--")
    ax.annotate("sel0",(sf[feat],ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.92),xytext=(6,0),textcoords="offset points",fontweight="bold")
    a=float(R.loc[R.feature==feat,"auc_transit_vs_cyto"].iloc[0])
    ax.set_title(f"{feat.replace('_',' ')}\nAUC = {a:.3f}",fontsize=11)
    ax.set_xlabel(feat.replace("_"," ")); ax.set_ylabel("density")
    ax.legend(fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("sel0 N-terminal 40 residues against S. pombe transit-peptide and cytosolic reference sets",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
